info.title: Quantitative Restrictions (QR)
info.description:
The database contains detailed information on export and import prohibitions and restrictions other than tariffs and taxes.
Details are available on the products (tariff lines) covered by the measure, the related WTO justification, national legal basis and administrative mechanisms.
